description: Power over Ethernet + the standards that rule them all
tagline: Power over Ethernet + the standards that rule them all

sections.title: What Is PoE?
sections.body: PoE (Power over Ethernet) sends ELECTRICITY through the same UTP cable that carries data. One cable powers AND connects cameras, Wi-Fi access points and IP phones — no power socket needed near the ceiling.

sections.title: Where PoE Shines
points: IP cameras — mount anywhere a cable reaches.
Wi-Fi access points — usually need PoE+ or higher.
VoIP phones — classic PoE is plenty.
One UPS on the PoE switch protects everything it powers.

sections.title: IEEE — The Rulebook Writer
sections.body: The IEEE publishes the standards everyone follows so gear from different vendors works together.
sections.tip: 💡 Exam tip: af=15W, at=30W ("t" comes after "f"... later letter, more power!). Ethernet=802.3, Wi-Fi=802.11.
